cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Could You Just…
cards.instruction: Turn a difficult task into tiny favors until the help quietly becomes most of the task.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could you hold my bouquet stems together? Flower heads level, please; we're making a bouquet, not sweeping the floor.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They're level. You need wire under that ribbon.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, a concealed binding. Could you twist this piece once, just below your fingers? Keep it tight.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Done, but the end will catch on the dress.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tuck it inward, please. Just wind the ribbon over it and tie one small bow. Smaller than that; I'll tell you when it's balanced.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 flower alignment, A3 concealed binding and A5 bow judging make expert corrections expand the tiny favours.
